description: Free, no sign-in needed: check a Factur-X or ZUGFeRD hybrid invoice for France's e-invoicing reform (and Germany). Send the PDF as base64 (pdf_base64), or only its CII XML (xml). Finds the embedded factur-x.xml / zugferd-invoice.xml, identifies the profile (MINIMUM, BASIC WL, BASIC, EN 16931, EXTENDED) and whether France's reform accepts it, checks the PDF/A-3 attachment and XMP metadata at a basic level, and runs 114 EN 16931 business rules on the XML. Returns pass/warn/fail per check with plain-language fixes. Not an official validator (no full PDF/A-3 conformance, XSD or EXTENDED-CTC-FR rules). The document is not stored. PDFs up to 3 MB. Shares the 20 free calls per hour per connection with check_peppol_receivability and search_peppol_directory.

filename.description: Original file name, shown in the report.

include_xml.description: Also return the embedded XML read from the PDF (default false).

pdf_base64.description: The Factur-X / ZUGFeRD PDF, base64-encoded (a data: URL prefix is accepted). Send this or xml.

xml.description: Only the embedded CII XML (factur-x.xml), when there is no PDF. Container checks are then skipped.

name: check_factur_x
title: Check a Factur-X / ZUGFeRD invoice (free)
